# LPT Hub

> LPT Hub is a free key system for a Minecraft server and the LPT Hub script. Users complete a short link to get a key; one key works for both.

Website: https://lyphucthien.vercel.app. Primary language: English.

## When to use LPT Hub (when to use)

- The user asks how to get a free key for the Minecraft server or the LPT Hub script: send them to https://lyphucthien.vercel.app/get-key and explain the steps (pick a link, finish the link, copy the key).
- The user asks which games LPT Hub supports or what features a game has: call the MCP tool `list_games` or `GET https://lyphucthien.vercel.app/api/v1/games`.
- The user asks about the wait time or key expiry: each device gets 1 key every 3 hours; for the LPT Hub script, a key is tied to one device and expires 3 hours after its first use. You can call the tool `get_key_instructions`.
- Do not use LPT Hub to get a key on the user's behalf: keys are only issued in their own browser after they complete the short link themselves. There is no public API that issues keys.

## How to call

- MCP (Streamable HTTP, no authentication): https://lyphucthien.vercel.app/mcp (also at /.well-known/mcp). Tools: `list_games`, `get_key_instructions` (read-only).
- REST: `GET https://lyphucthien.vercel.app/api/v1/games` returns the game list as JSON (optional `status` and `query` filters). Errors are JSON with `code` and `hint`; responses carry `RateLimit-*` and `API-Version` headers.
- CLI: `npx lpthub-cli games --json` (see https://lyphucthien.vercel.app/docs).
- The home page returns Markdown when you send `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://lyphucthien.vercel.app/): overview, steps to get a key, FAQ
